selectionPolicy: Complete generated poses only. Fixed canonical export; no class equipment offsets, body painting or limb transplants. Portrait strips repeat four untouched complete canvases and preserve original raw images.
notes: All thirty source strips and final representative equipment compositions inspected, one example by weapon structure. Both one-hand and two-hand axe structures were reviewed.

Saffron asymmetric wrap, ivory inset panels, copper piping, wooden collar beads, amber lotus clasp, cream crossbound forearm/calf wraps and dark split-toe shoes distinguish this advanced Monje specialization. Male short dark brown textured crop, female compact braided nape knot.
Corrected residual novice upper-arm sleeve fragments in male spear3/4 and dagger3; all upper arms remain bare.

Real wrapped palms, thumb/finger openings and visible equipment grips were compared with canonical anatomy. Some shared canonical points are occluded or lie outside visible hands; rendered weapon contact also informed selection.
Discarded candidates remain preserved. Female full walk v3 exceeds canonical bounds; male walk portrait v5 and bow portrait v4 have displaced grips and are unselected.
No shared equipment geometry changed. Candidate library generation does not activate new classes automatically.
